description: Purchasing through an AI assistant is temporarily unavailable. The customer can buy on https://gridgarden.eu. This tool does not create a cart; use studio_pricing_quote for the bill of materials and price.

country.description: Delivery market as an ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "DE", "AT", "SK"). Prices differ by market: SK is the base price list; every other market (CZ included) has its own list where structural pieces cost a little more (weight-based delivery surcharge; connector pins stay at base). Ask which country the order ships to; omit only if unknown — that returns SK (base) prices.

layers.description: Number of brick layers. Raised beds 2-13, walls 1-25 (1 = a single 60mm top-cap course). Each layer ≈120mm tall (top layer +60mm).

length1.description: L-shape: first leg length in mm.

length2.description: L-shape: second leg length in mm.

shape.description: Design type and the dimension fields it needs (all in mm, auto-snapped to the 60mm build grid): rectangle → length + width; lshape → length1 + width1 + length2 + width2; ushape → topLength + topWidth + arm1Length + arm1Width + arm2Length + arm2Width; wall → wallLength. Layers: raised beds 2–13, walls 1–25. Call studio_templates_list for ready example dimensions.

utm_source.description: Attribution source recorded on the Shopify cart (UTM). Defaults to "mcp".

wallLength.description: Wall: single straight segment length in mm.

width1.description: L-shape: first leg width in mm.

width2.description: L-shape: second leg width in mm.
